newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields close lower aided by Backstrom.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields close lower aided by Backstrom.

text.p: 1550 GMT - Swedish debt yields closed lower on Thursday and the crown firmed.
Stronger foreign markets and a speech by central bank governor Urban Backstrom lent support, dealers said.
* Six-month T-bill rates down one basis point to 4.22 pct
* Ten-year bond yields fell two basis points to 6.84 pct
* Crown firmed to 4.4510 against 4.4640 late on Wednesday
Swedish debt yields opened higher on Thursday to catch up with a German rise on Wednesday, but closed lower helped by stronger German and Spanish markets.
A speech by Riksbank Governor Urban Backstrom also lent support, dealers said.
Backstrom said the monetary policy is well balanced. He did not mention further room for repo cuts, but said the inflationary outlook pointed to lower long debt yields.
"The speech contributed to a flattening of the curve," one dealer said.
Six-month T-bill rate fell one basis point to 4.22 percent.
The ten-year bond yields fell two basis points to 6.84 percent.
The spread between Swedish and German long yields decreased four basis points to 115.
The crown firmed to 4.4510 versus 4.4640 late on Wednesday in line with the stronger dollar and supported by Backstrom's speech. He said the crown is undervalued given underlying economical factors.
